svg.text: From Unconstrained "AI Slop" to Governed Engineering Precision

g.text: ⚠️ Defaulting to generic internet-average cliches
• Cliche purple/blue gradients & gradient text headings
• Glowing neon borders (box-shadow: 0 0 20px #8b5cf6)
• "Card Soup": Card inside card inside card
• Pill buttons (rounded-full) for every standard action
• 64px+ gratuitous empty whitespace in productivity tools
• Fake vanity KPI metric tiles with arbitrary sparklines
• Massive 80px marketing banners inside internal consoles
• Component library default demo feel (zero calibration)
• Only designs the Ideal State; fails on errors or loading
• Trusting JSX code without checking real browser render
🛡️ Explicit Product Context & Clinical Precision Archetype
• Monochrome dark slate base (#090d16) with 1px borders
• Strict 4px/8px spatial scale (4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32px)
• Disciplined corner radiuses (sm: 4px, md: 6px, lg: 8px)
• High information density: tables & structured data lists
• Typography hierarchy defines grouping before containers
• Single calibrated accent color (#0284c7) for primary CTAs
• Mandatory 10 Product States (Loading, Empty, Error, Overflow...)
• Automated Anti-Slop Linter checks before commit
• Headless browser captures multi-viewport screenshot evidence
• WCAG 2.1 AA accessible contrast & full keyboard navigation
